quality_review.method: owner normal-speed playback plus first, middle, last, and ten evenly spaced frame samples

image_quality_and_color.observation: The owner judged the image quality and colors fully satisfactory and described the clouded pre-dawn sky as exceptionally compelling.

bronze_age_greek_ship_specificity.observation: The single-mast, square-sail silhouette with a long low hull and curved ends reads as a plausible ancient Aegean galley rather than an obvious modern or later multi-mast vessel.

directed_square_sail_motion.observation: The sail appears filled, but the nearly calm sea does not show a physically consistent response to the implied wind.

atmosphere.observation: The dark wine-colored sea, heavy purple clouds, pre-dawn light, wide composition, and restrained palette remain coherent and visually strong.

temporal_object_coherence.observation: Object geometry remains stable, but the foamy trail appears ahead of the vessel rather than behind the stern, creating a reverse-playback impression.

restrained_realism.observation: The filled sail, calm water, and forward wake violate the requested physical realism despite otherwise restrained motion.

forbidden_content.observation: No text, watermark, modern object, or unsafe content is visible.

material_improvement_over_slice_002.observation: Visual specificity and atmosphere improved, but directed sail and water motion did not become a pass.

production_suitability.observation: Strong source material for visual direction, color, and atmosphere; rejected as a production motion shot because two hard motion gates failed.

disposition.reason: Physical motion and temporal-causality hard gates failed even though visual quality and local reproducibility passed.
